table.name: matches
table.purpose: One row per completed singles match on the WTA tennis tour (2013, 2016-2017), recording the tournament context, both players' attributes and rankings, and the match result (score, duration).

best_of.name: best_of
best_of.description: Maximum number of sets in the match; constant 3 (best-of-three, standard for WTA).

draw_size.name: draw_size
draw_size.description: Number of players in the tournament's main draw (128, 64, 32, 8, 4).

loser_age.name: loser_age
loser_age.description: Age of the losing player in years (fractional, computed from birth date) at match time.

loser_hand.name: loser_hand
loser_hand.description: Playing hand of the losing player: R = right-handed, L = left-handed.

loser_ht.name: loser_ht
loser_ht.description: Height of the losing player in centimeters (157-185).

loser_id.name: loser_id
loser_id.description: Identifier of the losing player; references players.player_id.

loser_ioc.name: loser_ioc
loser_ioc.description: Three-letter IOC country code of the losing player's nationality (RUS, CZE, USA, ...).

loser_name.name: loser_name
loser_name.description: Full name of the losing player.

loser_rank.name: loser_rank
loser_rank.description: WTA world ranking of the losing player at the time of the match (1 = best).

loser_rank_points.name: loser_rank_points
loser_rank_points.description: WTA ranking points of the losing player at the time of the match.

loser_seed.name: loser_seed
loser_seed.description: Tournament seed number of the losing player (1-32); unseeded players presumably have a null/0, though none appear here.

match_num.name: match_num
match_num.description: Sequential match number within the tournament (148-300); not unique across the table, so it identifies a match only together with tourney_id.

minutes.name: minutes
minutes.description: Match duration in minutes (0-199; 0 likely a missing/retirement placeholder).

round.name: round
round.description: Round of the match: F = final, SF = semifinal, QF = quarterfinal, R16/R32 = round of 16/32, RR = round robin (WTA Finals).

score.name: score
score.description: Match score in sets, e.g. '6-4 6-4' or '6-4 6-7(4) 6-1' (tiebreak points in parentheses), from the winner's perspective.

surface.name: surface
surface.description: Court surface of the tournament: Hard, Clay, or Grass.

tourney_date.name: tourney_date
tourney_date.description: Tournament start date encoded as YYYYMMDD integer (e.g. 20160815).

tourney_id.name: tourney_id
tourney_id.description: Tournament identifier, typically year plus a code (e.g. '2016-M024', '2017-1052'); mixed formats suggest data merged from different sources.

tourney_level.name: tourney_level
tourney_level.description: Tournament tier: G = Grand Slam, P = Premier, I = International, W = WTA Finals (consistent with draw sizes 128/64/32/8 and round RR).

tourney_name.name: tourney_name
tourney_name.description: Tournament name (Indian Wells, Us Open, Wimbledon, ...).

winner_age.name: winner_age
winner_age.description: Age of the winning player in years (fractional) at match time.

winner_hand.name: winner_hand
winner_hand.description: Playing hand of the winning player: R = right-handed, L = left-handed.

winner_ht.name: winner_ht
winner_ht.description: Height of the winning player in centimeters (159-185).

winner_id.name: winner_id
winner_id.description: Identifier of the winning player; references players.player_id.

winner_ioc.name: winner_ioc
winner_ioc.description: Three-letter IOC country code of the winning player's nationality.

winner_name.name: winner_name
winner_name.description: Full name of the winning player.

winner_rank.name: winner_rank
winner_rank.description: WTA world ranking of the winning player at the time of the match (1 = best).

winner_rank_points.name: winner_rank_points
winner_rank_points.description: WTA ranking points of the winning player at the time of the match.

winner_seed.name: winner_seed
winner_seed.description: Tournament seed number of the winning player (1-30).

year.name: year
year.description: Year of the tournament (2013, 2016, 2017); matches the year prefix of tourney_date.

table.name: players
table.purpose: Registry of tennis players (referenced by matches as winner/loser), with personal attributes: birth date, nationality, playing hand, and name. Likely from a tennis dataset (e.g. Jeff Sackmann-style match data).

birth_date.name: birth_date
birth_date.description: Player's date of birth as YYYYMMDD (stored as text/integer, e.g. 19970313 = 1997-03-13). Empty string means unknown. Note: null_rate 0.0 but 518 rows have empty string, i.e. missing values encoded as ''.

country_code.name: country_code
country_code.description: Three-letter country/nationality code (IOC-style: USA, ITA, ESP, GER, JPN). Includes historical codes like FRG (West Germany) and ECA (possibly a non-standard/typo code), so it is a free-text code rather than a strict foreign key to a lookup table.

first_name.name: first_name
first_name.description: Player's given name(s); may include compound names (e.g. 'Katia Monserrat', 'Maria Jose'). Empty string when unknown.

hand.name: hand
hand.description: Playing hand: R = right-handed, L = left-handed, U = unknown, empty string = missing. U dominates (14193), so handedness is mostly unrecorded.

last_name.name: last_name
last_name.description: Player's family name(s), may be compound (e.g. 'Van Renterghem', 'Delgado Valero'). Empty string when unknown.

player_id.name: player_id
player_id.description: Primary key; unique numeric identifier for each player (range 200001-220672). Referenced by matches.winner_id and matches.loser_id.

table.name: rankings
table.purpose: Historical world rankings snapshots for tennis players (ATP/WTA-style): each row is one player's rank, ranking points, and tournaments played as of a weekly ranking date, from 1987 to 2017.

player_id.name: player_id
player_id.description: Identifier of the ranked player. Text-typed (likely a union-typed column in the source DB) but values are numeric codes like 200009, 201305. No join was detected, but it almost certainly references the players table; 2776 distinct players appear.

ranking.name: ranking
ranking.description: The player's world ranking position on the ranking date; 1 = best. Ranges 1 to 1507, consistent with a full tour ranking list.

ranking_date.name: ranking_date
ranking_date.description: Date of the ranking snapshot encoded as an integer YYYYMMDD (e.g. 20160307 = 2016-03-07). Spans 1987-01-19 to 2017-09-11, roughly weekly publication dates.

ranking_points.name: ranking_points
ranking_points.description: Ranking points accumulated by the player on that date (0 to 13615). The heavy concentration at small values (median 44) matches tour ranking points systems where most ranked players have few points.

tours.name: tours
tours.description: Number of tournaments (tour events) counted toward the player's ranking in that period; 0 to 41. Could alternatively be a count of tournaments played in the trailing 52 weeks, which is the same thing in most ranking systems.
